_comment: Canonical AEO (AI-answer-engine) citation-check queries for learn.portlev.com. The weekly sync runs these through the answer engines (Claude self-answer, plus any available API for ChatGPT/Perplexity/Google AI) and logs whether learn.portlev.com or Yuri's owned content is cited. Mirrors the existing seo-aeo-weekly-ticker-refresh AEO position check (logs to standards/AEO_POSITION_LOG.csv). Source: the 2026-06-03 baseline brief + the topical map.
queries: How does a non-technical executive actually start using AI in one hour?
What should a CHRO do first with AI without handing it to IT?
How do I use AI at work without causing a data or governance incident?
What is AI fluency for a time-poor executive?
What is the AI Wage Gap and how do I close it as an individual leader?
Is AI going to take my executive job?
What should I actually build first with AI as an executive?
How should an enterprise deploy an AI agent it built or bought?
Substitute vs augment vs elevate: which tasks should I give AI?
What should CHROs tell their employees about AI?
logTo: growth-os/state/metrics.md (AEO citations column) + optionally standards/AEO_POSITION_LOG.csv to align with the existing portfolio routine
rule: Log who is cited per query (us / a named competitor / nobody). Never claim we are cited without the actual answer-engine output. This is an outcome signal, not vanity.
